## Scope

The quality audit covered a sample of graded sets from 2025 Q1. Each set in the sample was read again by a second grader to assess consistency between the original grading and the repeat assessment. The audit sample reads: 591. This review provides an overall measure of grading agreement and supports routine quality assurance. It does not replace the detailed review of individual grading outcomes.

## Result

The agreement between the first and second grades was 65.7 per cent of sets. This result provides the overall agreement measure for the audited sample. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet for review. They are also discussed with each grader privately, allowing the findings to be considered in the appropriate context and any follow-up to be addressed directly. The spreadsheet and individual discussions should be read together when considering the audit result.
